runtime.name: vllm
runtime.source_revision_role: Official vLLM v0.29.0 release with matched CUDA 12.9 and CUDA 13.0 images, Qwen3.5-family hybrid-model, NVFP4, and native MTP serving support.

requirements.gpu_architecture: NVIDIA Blackwell; NVFP4 activation arithmetic requires SM100 or newer
requirements.nvfp4_backend: FlashInfer/CUTLASS on Blackwell; older GPUs use a weight-only fallback and are not a supported PreFer lane
requirements.driver_note: Choose the explicit CUDA variant that matches the host driver; CUDA 13 normally requires an R580-or-newer driver.

hf.verification: exact catalog size and SHA-256 before atomic publication

features.structured_output: vLLM guided decoding; exact schema smoke required
features.kv_cache: FP8 KV is the performance default; calibration and long-context quality remain smoke gates
features.speculative_decoding: native Qwen3.5-family MTP head through vLLM speculative_config
features.transport: native vLLM OpenAI-compatible server; no PreFer inference proxy

qwen-3.8-flash.reason: Official recipe requires the dedicated qwen38-flash-next image and multi-GB300-class deployments; it is not part of this first 27B lane.

dflash2.reason: vLLM exposes DFlash2 for Qwen3.8 only in newer releases; do not replace the verified native MTP path without a matched artifact and smoke.

known_limitations: The checked-in deployment scenarios are configuration-only until an exact Blackwell card passes load, API, context, and throughput smoke.
Native MTP is first enabled at TP1; current qwen3_5_mtp TP>=2 loader issues are intentionally not hidden by a multi-GPU default.
The vLLM recipe verifies text serving; image and video input remain native capability metadata until the PreFer multimodal smoke passes.
A 32 GB Blackwell route may require enforce-eager and a smaller context because CUDA graph capture can OOM outside the model memory budget.
Model weights are runtime artifacts and never belong in this image or grouped release artifact.

cuda12.build_revision_note: Official CUDA 12.9 Ubuntu 24.04 vLLM v0.29.0 image.

cuda13.build_revision_note: Official CUDA 13.0 Ubuntu 24.04 vLLM v0.29.0 image.
